errors.text_span: Von links nach rechts repräsentiert innerhalb einer Gruppe der hellgrüne Balken das 'Welt-BIP', der blassgrüne Balken den 'Welthandel', der dunkelblaue Balken die 'Exporte Deutschland' und der hellblaue Balken die 'Industrieproduktion Deutschland'.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the 'Welt-BIP' is represented by the hellgrüne (light green) bar and 'Welthandel' by the blassgrüne (pale green) bar. In the figure, 'Welt-BIP' is represented by the dunkelgrüne (dark green) bar and 'Welthandel' by the hellgrüne (light green) bar.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the average percentage values of global GDP, global trade, German exports, and German industrial production.
The description does not mention the label of the vertical axis ('Durchschnitte in %').
The description does not mention the explicit labeling of the bars with their numerical values, which is a key visual feature of the chart.
